name: Breakout Box
design_intent:
TRIALS DESTROY_ALL proof course (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.3, owner example t_breakout_box). Smash every destructible_block ringing a central launch pad over the void WITHOUT over-launching into the pit. The clear-test is the umbrella group 'destructible' emptying (last block breaks). A fall respawns at start_gate (+2s), never ends the course.

DESIGN vs current Tuning: a central trampoline pad (x760 w400, top 1080) is the safe footing; five destructible blocks (break_on 'hit', hp 1 -> one solid >=300px/s bounce breaks each after a 0.28s crack telegraph) sit within a single boost of the pad: three in an arc overhead (break by boosting UP into them) + one on each side (break by boosting sideways). Every block is a trampoline-tier SURFACE so a clean contact both bounces you and lands the hit. normal_boost_max 760px/s reaches each block from the pad; the risk is over-boosting past a block into the void => a fall (+2s). No block is anyone's sole footing (the central pad always remains) so there is no softlock (D-SOFTLOCK n/a here -- that gate binds t_glass_floor).

MEDAL (time, faster better): a clean run breaks 5 blocks in ~9-15s. gold 12.0 / silver 20.0 / bronze 35.0.
